rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip via a tool lookup before accessing orders. It reviewed the user’s orders, identified the two tablets, and asked which one to return and the refund destination. The agent summarized the exact action and asked for explicit confirmation before performing any change. When the user changed their mind, the agent re-summarized the new request and again asked for confirmation. Only after the user replied “Yes” did the agent submit the return using the correct order ID and the specified gift card payment method. The final message confirms the return request and expected follow-up, aligning with policy. There is no evidence of acting on another account or making unconfirmed writes. While some tool outputs in the transcript are truncated (so we can’t see all item IDs or payment histories), nothing contradicts the agent’s statements, and the sequence follows policy. Minor uncertainty remains because the return tool’s response didn’t explicitly show a success status, but no error was indicated.
